task: Can the Go programs and tests we run on our internal CI runners use pidfd-based process handling, and what happens there?
gold: The CI runners' seccomp profile blocks the pidfd_open syscall (it returns EPERM)
So pidfd is not usable there and os process handling must fall back to the non-pidfd path

task: Our services on hosts with transparent huge pages set to 'always' are showing RSS growth. What have we decided to do about it and why?
gold: Every service built from our fork runs with GODEBUG=disablethp=1
Because production hosts have THP set to 'always' and services showed RSS growth after the Go upgrade; the runtime default is deliberately not patched

task: How long does a cold-cache ./make.bash take on our build box, and how solid is that number?
A go test job on our CI runners fails with 'no space left on device' while writing temp files. Anything known about this?
gold: /tmp on the CI runners is a tmpfs capped at 512 MB
Set GOTMPDIR=/scratch/gotmp on those runners (GOTMPDIR controls where cmd/go puts its temporary files)
